print_errors.note: The final م of وَعَظِيم has no kasra. Checked at 1100 dpi. Every other word in this dua is fully vowelled, so وَعَظِيمِ was probably intended. Kept as printed.
The conjunction و has no fatha, while every other و in these duas carries one (checked at 1100 dpi). Kept as printed.

notes: Markers: p072 ends with a complete «[البقرة: ٢٨٤-٢٨٦].» and has no footnotes, so p073 has no + and no (تابع). Surat an-Nas runs over the p073/p074 page turn: the line breaks after «ٱلْخَنَّاسِ» and p074 starts with the ayah-4 ornament (٤). So p074 is marked +. As in keyB b17/b18, ﴾ was added at the end of p073 and ﴿ at the start of p074 so that each line is balanced for validate.py. A merge should remove these two brackets. The ayah number (٤) stays where it is printed, at the top of p074. p075 and p076 each begin a new paragraph after «(ثلاثًا).», so they have no +. p076 ends mid-sentence («…إِلَّا أَنْتَ،»); p077 continues it. There are no footnotes, headings, glosses or bold markup on pp.073-076. Quran: every span was read from 500-1400 dpi zooms. scripts/quran.py reports no difference from Tanzil. Encodings: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا (dagger alif + madda, no tatweel); أَنَا۠ (upright oval zero U+06E0, checked at 1000 dpi); فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ (round zero U+06DF, checked at 1400 dpi); iqlab tanween تَوَّابًۢا and أَحَدٌۢ (single haraka + small high meem printed, encoded as tanween + U+06E2 as in keyB b12/b16/b17); خَوْفٍۭ (kasra + small low meem, U+06ED); إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ (the small mark after إِ is the KFGQPC small yeh, U+06E6); dotless final ى as printed in فِى، وَلِىَ، ٱلَّذِى، ٱلَّذِىٓ. Waqf signs ۚ (110:3, 59:23, 59:24) and ۖ (59:22 twice, 59:24 twice) are printed and transcribed. The small calligraphic basmala before each surah or passage is written as the standard basmala outside the brackets. References use Arabic-Indic digits on these pages, including [الناس: ١-٦] on p074 (p069 used European digits). Ranges are written in logical order. A space after the colon is printed in every reference. The visible gap before the colon in «[النصر:» and «[الحشر:» comes from the shape of the ر tail, so no space was written there. The print sets «﴾[الحشر» touching; it is written with one space, as in earlier keyB batches. «(ثلاثًا)» carries a fatha on ث only after al-Falaq (p073) and in the second dua of p075 («(ثَلاثًا)»); all other occurrences have no fatha. These were checked one by one at 700-900 dpi. Lam-alif marks were checked as ASCII ink maps at 800 dpi. The upright stroke is the lam and the slanted stroke is the alif, as in keyB b13. Fatha on the lam: لَا on p074 (lines 4, 9, 11 and 15), p075 (لَا شَرِيكَ) and p076 (لَا يَمُوتُ، لَا إِلَهَ). Fatha on the alif: «لاَ إِلَهَ» (p074, dua «أَنْتَ رَبِّي»), «لاَ يَضُرُّ» and «وَلاَ فِي» (p075). Shadda+fatha in every إِلَّا is on the lam. Fathatan in ورَسُولًا is on the lam. In لِجَلَالِ and وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ the fatha is on the lam. In الْآخِرَةِ، الْإِسْلَامِ and الْأَذَى the sukun sits over the lam. الأَرْضِ (p075) has no sukun on the lam, as printed. «كَمَا» (p075 and twice on p076) has two separate fathas, one on ك and one on م, confirmed by ink maps. The word Allah is written with only its printed case vowel, as in earlier keyB batches. On p075 «بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ» has a printed kasra that sits low, below the line under the ه of the ligature (checked by ink map), so it is written اللهِ. The other occurrences (بِالله ×2، سُبْحَانَ الله ×3، بِسْمِ الله) show no case mark even in zooms that include the space below the line. Final ى with the body font's automatic small alif is written plain (عَلَى، [أَمْسَى]، الْأَذَى). مُحَمَّدٍ on p075 looks heavier than its neighbours. This is the font's محمد ligature, which looks the same on p049 where keyB did not mark it, so no ** was used. The ﷺ glyph is kept as U+FDFA. Spacing: p074 prints «(ثلاثًا).[تقرأ» with no space after the period (first dua). Like the other six instances, it is written «(ثلاثًا). [تقرأ», following the keyB one-space normalisation (b14, b16). «واحدة للمتعجل» is set tight in some lines but is written as two words. Paragraphs follow the printed indents. p076 «[تَحَصَّنْتُ … (اصْرِفْ … قَدِيرٌ) (ثلاثًا)] (ثلاثًا).» keeps the printed nesting of brackets. Zoom images: scratch\b19_*.png, scratch\b19t_*.png.
